title: One Piece’s Luffy Haunts The World of Shonen Jump in Wild Crossover
content: The legend of the Grand Line has become one of the greatest adventures in anime history, and for good reason. Even decades following One Piece’s debut, shonen fans are still following along with the story of the Straw Hat Pirates as the grand finale continues to play out.
author: ComicBook

title: New Dragon Ball Super Anime Disappoints With Surprise Release Update
content: Dragon Ball Super is now in the works on coming back with a brand new anime for the Galactic Patrol Prisoner arc , and an unfortunate update from Toei Animation teases that it’s going to be a much longer wait for fans are hoping for.
author: ComicBook

title: Eren the Southpaw Manga Ends
content: Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ published the final chapter of the new serialization of Kappi and nifuni 's Hidarikiki no Eren ( Eren the Southpaw ) manga on Wednesday. The 26th and final compiled book volume ships on September 4.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Series How Do We Relationship? Reveals 7 More Cast Members
content: The staff for the live-action series adaptation of Tamifull 's How Do We Relationship? ( Tsukiatte Agete mo Ii ka na ) manga unveiled the main visual and seven more cast members on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Reveals Close New Look at Its Next Avatar Ahead of Her Debut
content: Avatar: Seven Havens is a brand new sequel TV series now in the works with Avatar Studios, and it has revealed a close new look at the next Avatar taking over from Korra after The Legend of Korra .
author: ComicBook

title: Manga Mavericks Books Hosts Horon of The Closed Country Creator Sen at Anime NYC 2026
content: Manga Mavericks Books announced on Monday that it will host Horon of the Closed Country manga creator Sen at the Anime NYC 2026 event. The company will host autograph sessions for the author, along with a panel on August 21 at 3:30 p.m. EDT.
author: ANN

title: HIDIVE to Stream 'Tetsuryō! meet with Tetsudō Musume' Anime With World Premiere Screening at Anime NYC on August 21
content: HIDIVE announced on Tuesday that it will stream Tetsuryō! meet with Tetsudō Musume , the original television anime based on the Tetsudō Musume (Railway Girls) characters, for the fall 2027 season in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand.
author: ANN

title: One of Anime’s Most Legendary Sci-Fi Series Planning Special Theatrical Run in Japan With New Art
content: While you can’t seem to escape anime these days, as streaming services like Netflix, Hulu, and Crunchyroll share their fair share of anime offerings, this was once far from the case.
author: ComicBook

title: My Hero Academia Creator Breaks Silence on Shonen Jump Return After 2 Years
content: My Hero Academia creator Kohei Horikoshi has officially made his return to Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine with a brand new story after two years, and the creator has opened up about his comeback.
author: ComicBook

title: Nippon Ichi Software's Gobble Side-Scrolling Game Heads West in 2027
content: NIS America announced on Tuesday that it will release Nippon Ichi Software 's GOBBLE , a new side-scrolling game , in the West in 2027 for Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam .
author: ANN
